_description: Hyprland dispatch recipes indexed by major.minor version and action. Window-targeting recipes search by class, title, or address and focus the target before applying the action.

focus_workspace.description: Switch focus to workspace number or name

move_to_workspace.script:
local target_win = nil
local id = [[{window}]]
if id ~= '' then
  for _, w in ipairs(hl.get_windows()) do
    if w.address == id or w.class:lower():find(id:lower(), 1, true) or w.title:lower():find(id:lower(), 1, true) then
      target_win = w
      break
    end
  end
end
if target_win then
  hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.focus({ window = target_win }))
end
local res = hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.window.move({ workspace = {target} }))
return res and res.ok or false
move_to_workspace.description: Move window (by class/title/address) or active window to target workspace

close_window.script:
local target_win = nil
local id = [[{window}]]
if id ~= '' then
  for _, w in ipairs(hl.get_windows()) do
    if w.address == id or w.class:lower():find(id:lower(), 1, true) or w.title:lower():find(id:lower(), 1, true) then
      target_win = w
      break
    end
  end
end
if target_win then
  hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.focus({ window = target_win }))
  local res = hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.window.close({ window = target_win }))
  return res and res.ok or false
else
  local res = hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.window.close())
  return res and res.ok or false
end
close_window.description: Close specified window (by class/title/address) or currently active window
